Chapter 1262: Chapter 18: Thousands of Years Passed (Please Subscribe)

The successful development of twelve particle worlds signifies that Lin Yuan can continue down this path.

Being able to develop and maintain twelve particle worlds, he can also develop and maintain one hundred and twenty particle worlds, twelve billion particle worlds… even infinite Constant Sand Particle Worlds.

But similarly.

This will also give rise to another problem.

And that is resources.

The development of worlds is not created out of thin air.

It requires vast amounts of resources to support.

Compared to internal worlds and universes, particle worlds are much smaller, and the consumption of resources will be significantly reduced.

But the quantity is overwhelming.

Now, having developed twelve particle worlds, Lin Yuan can still manage to support it. But what about one hundred and twenty particle worlds? Or twelve hundred particle worlds?

“Qingyun Saint Sect?”

Lin Yuan thought of his sect. As a hegemonic force before the great changes in the world, even though Qingyun Saint Sect had declined from repeated Demon attacks, its foundation was still strong.

If Lin Yuan were to acquire all the resources of Qingyun Saint Sect, it could indeed support the development of particle worlds for a long time.

But this is only a temporary solution, not a fundamental one.

The entirety of Qingyun Saint Sect’s resources, even if it could support the development up to twelve hundred particle worlds, what then?

Where will the resources come from for the development of twelve thousand particle worlds, or one hundred and twenty thousand particle worlds?

Besides, no matter how you look at it, Qingyun Saint Sect is still the sect of the ‘original self’, and Lin Yuan is not willing to take too much.

“There still needs to be a stable way to acquire a large amount of resources.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In this Fang Yuan World, in terms of resource abundance, naturally, it is the center of the world. However, today the center of the world is the place where Demonic Qi is the densest, and traces of Source Demons are often present.

Until his strength is restored to its peak, Lin Yuan is reluctant to go over there.

Even if his strength is restored to its peak, without a method to deal with Source Demons, Lin Yuan would also be reluctant to go there.

“Myriad Realms Gate…”

Lin Yuan recalled receiving resources from the first Source World for his cultivation.

He holds an extraordinary position in the first Source World, even the six Ancestors would engage with him, thus acquiring enough resources to develop particle worlds was not a problem.

But the key is sending items through the Myriad Realms Gate as an ‘intermediary’ to another dimensional space, which requires the World-Breaking Origin Force as a cost.

For example, in several traversals before Lin Yuan reached the Twelfth Level, he would often transport the Origin Clock and the Mysterious Gourd to the traversal worlds for his own cultivation.

Of course, this consumed several strands of World-Breaking Origin Force.

Several strands of World-Breaking Origin Force are indeed not much, but they were limited to sending the Origin Clock and the Mysterious Gourd, these two items.

If the number of items increases, or their ‘mass’ becomes greater, the consumption of World-Breaking Origin Force will naturally rise as well.

And the resources consumed by Lin Yuan in developing particle worlds are countless like mountains and seas. Solely relying on the Myriad Realms Gate to send them over, the consumption of World-Breaking Origin Force would probably be calculated in millions to tens of millions of strands.

“Forget it.”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

How much of the World-Breaking Origin Force had he painstakingly accumulated until now? He valued each strand greatly, and if he consumed so much World-Breaking Origin Force just to develop particle worlds, Lin Yuan would rather cultivate directly in the first Source World.

“The resources for developing particle worlds should still be placed in this Source World.”

Lin Yuan thought in his heart that sending resources through the Myriad Realms Gate was a cost too high, too much for Lin Yuan to bear.

“The resources of this Source World…”

Lin Yuan looked up beyond Qingyun Sacred Mountain. Since the great change of heaven and earth, what is most abundant in this Source World?

Demonic Qi.

Demonic Qi present everywhere.

“Demonic Qi?”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned slightly grave. He had once studied Demonic Qi and determined that it was an advanced kind of power, otherwise those who entered the demon state would not have an immediate increase in strength once Demonic Qi began to assimilate.

But Lin Yuan had not attempted whether Demonic Qi could be converted into energy and then absorbed and devoured.

Because countless strong individuals in this Fang Yuan World had tried, and Demonic Qi could not be absorbed. If forcibly absorbed, it would lead to assimilation by Demonic Qi, thus becoming one who has entered the demon state.

The hidden dangers of those who enter the demon state are known to any cultivator.

As the degree of entering the demon state increases, the emotions of the one who entered will gradually fade until finally, memories are swiftly erased, turning them into a powerful, zombie-like ‘demon’.

“Cultivators in this Fang Yuan World can’t absorb Demonic Qi, but it doesn’t mean I can’t.”

With a subtle thought, Lin Yuan intertwined a deep power between his fingers, which was exactly Demonic Qi.

Beyond Qingyun Sacred Mountain, the pervasive Demonic Qi was everywhere. Obtaining a strand of Demonic Qi was no trouble for Lin Yuan.

“Absorb?”

Lin Yuan carefully observed this strand of Demonic Qi.

Direct absorption is certainly not feasible.

Demonic Qi would directly erode the mind and will.

Though with the strength of Lin Yuan’s mind and will, he could completely resist it, there’s no need to invite unnecessary trouble.

“Chaos Tai Chi Diagram.”

With a subtle thought, a Taiji Diagram composed of one Yin and one Yang appeared before him.

As a path of Chaos Power that Lin Yuan had evolved himself, with a mere thought, he could directly gather and activate it.

Buzzzzz.

The black and white Tai Chi Diagram rotated, faintly beginning to permeate the layers of space-time around it.

Lin Yuan directly placed that strand of Demonic Qi beside the Chaos Tai Chi Diagram.

The Chaos Tai Chi Diagram, with its Yin and Yang, black and white, swallowed that strand of Demonic Qi like a grinding disc.

The Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Dao, originating from chaos, possesses the ability to transform everything into chaos.

The strand of Demonic Qi was swallowed by the Chaos Tai Chi Yin Yang Diagram and was continuously crushed by the black and white grinding disc.

But after being crushed, the essence of the Demonic Qi did not change; it remained Demonic Qi.

Then it was crushed again.

After repeating this process hundreds of times, that wisp of demonic qi finally transformed into some kind of pure power.

“Is this the essence of demonic qi?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up as he closely observed the pure power.

“Let’s see.”

Lin Yuan immediately began to absorb it.

“It can be absorbed and refined.”

“It’s very suitable for developing the particle world.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. In this way, the biggest problem of resource scarcity in developing the Constant Sand Particle World was resolved.

“However, the pure power formed after a wisp of demonic qi returns to its origin is really too little.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the resources consumed in developing the Constant Sand Particle World weren’t something a few wisps of demonic qi could support.

“It seems those demons…”

Lin Yuan was slightly stirred inside. The so-called demons are essentially bred from dense demonic qi, and the demons themselves are highly concentrated demonic qi aggregates.

It’s predictable that the demons refined by the Yin Yang Great Grinding Disc can provide Lin Yuan with pure power far beyond just a few wisps of demonic qi.

“I’ll go out now and give it a try.”

Lin Yuan felt a stir in his heart and immediately left Qingyun Sacred Mountain silently.

Over the years at Qingyun Institute, with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he had long studied the Sect Protection Array of Qingyun Sacred Mountain thoroughly.

Not to mention entering and exiting Qingyun Sacred Mountain silently, even directly mastering the entire Qingyun Array was no big deal.

…

Outside Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

Demonic qi wafted.

Lin Yuan searched carefully and finally discovered a demon spirit.

Although this demon spirit’s size wasn’t as majestic as the demon that attacked the mountain, it was also a million li long, lying there quietly inhaling and exhaling demonic qi between heaven and earth.

Not every demon likes to wander around; many demons prefer to stay in one place, slowly inhaling and exhaling demonic qi.

“It’s you then.”

Lin Yuan looked at that demon spirit, a million li-sized demon spirit? How many wisps of demonic qi did it contain?

Not to mention, the composition of a demon spirit is essentially a high concentration of demonic qi gathered together. Once such a demon is refined by Lin Yuan, who knows how many resources it would equate to.

“Quick battle and quick resolution.”

Looking at the massive demon spirit not far away, Lin Yuan directly activated the Chaotic Tai Chi Diagram for suppression.

“Roar!!”

This demon spirit, which was originally sleeping soundly, suddenly felt its inhalation of demonic qi interrupted, and instantly became enraged.

Demons don’t have complex thoughts, but they do have simple notions like curiosity or anger?

The so-called great demon attacking the mountain was due to its curiosity towards Qingyun Sacred Mountain, leading it to attempt an attack. Later, when it discovered nothing changed, it lost interest and left.

“Suppress!”

Lin Yuan activated the Chaotic Tai Chi Diagram; as a disciple of the Qingyun Saint Sect, he originally possessed eleventh rank peak strength, and over the years of cultivation, his true strength had long restored to the Dominator realm.

With Dominator realm strength, activating the Chaotic Tai Chi Diagram, not to mention a mere demon spirit, even a great demon would be forced to flee.

Shortly thereafter.

The million li-sized demon spirit was suppressed by Lin Yuan.

“Refine.”

Lin Yuan drew the demon spirit into his internal universe and immediately activated the Chaotic Tai Chi Diagram, continuously grinding it down.

Swish swish.

The giant body of the demon spirit quickly shattered, soon transforming into the purest power, which was swiftly absorbed by Lin Yuan.

“In a way, I’m actually quite similar to those who have gone mad with demonic influence.”

As Lin Yuan devoured and absorbed the pure power converted from demonic qi, he thought to himself.

The only difference is that while also devouring demons, Lin Yuan absorbs only the demons that have been ground into the purest state by the Chaos Taiji Grinding Plate, posing no impact on himself.

In fact, with the means of this Origin World, there must be similar methods to refine demons and then absorb them, like Lin Yuan.

However, doing so, demonic qi turned into the purest power, loses that rapid enhancement effect on strength.

What cultivators in this world lack isn’t resources, but strength to counter demons.

Days later.

Lin Yuan successfully refined that demon spirit.

“It’s enough for me to develop more than three hundred particle worlds.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. If a demon spirit alone had such an effect, how much more could those great demons or even source demons help Lin Yuan?

Of course, in the short term, Lin Yuan will only target demon spirits and great demons. As for source demons? Even if his full strength were restored, Lin Yuan wouldn’t easily target source demons.

According to the conclusions drawn by Lin Yuan from the various ancient books he saw at Qingyun Institute.

The so-called source demons are most likely related to the legendary Demon Gods in some way.

Recklessly refining a source demon might invite the gaze of a Demon God.

If Lin Yuan’s speculation is correct, the Demon Gods of this Origin World correspond to thirteenth-tier time lifeforms.

And judging by the behavior of many demons, it’s estimated that the Demon Gods aren’t particularly intelligent, not like the six great ancestors, who would look into Lin Yuan’s future timeline beforehand and then choose to form a friendship.

“Time to return.”

Lin Yuan immediately decided to return to Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

The vast energy obtained from refining that demon spirit was enough for Lin Yuan to cultivate for a period.

And so.

Lin Yuan would quietly leave Qingyun Sacred Mountain from time to time to hunt demons outside, fueling his development of particle worlds.

Time flew by quickly.

In the blink of an eye, a thousand years had passed.
